name: The empty roost
desc: Claw marks, scorched stone, a nest built from whole trees. Whatever made them is not home.

shots.desc: a roost on a jagged mountain peak, the stone gouged by huge claws and scorched black, a nest built from whole broken tree trunks, sheer drop on every side, distant peaks far below, wind-torn cloud, extreme wide shot, no humans
climbing the last of the scorched rock on hands and knees, torn and dirt-stained clothing, mud and rust on worn armour, breathing hard, seen from behind, medium shot
a rib bone taller than a man half buried in the nest of splintered trunks, claw gouges in the rock beside it, extreme close-up, no humans
head turning slowly to look up and out of frame, wide eyes, shrunken pupils, dirt dried across the face, close-up
one small figure standing at the edge of the claw-scored stone, sheer drop and distant peaks below, wind-torn cloud, wide shot, full body

why: The place card is emphatic that naming the dragon gets you a portrait of a dragon instead of a location, so this template never names one and never shows one. The creature exists only as scale marks - gouges, scorching, bones, a nest made of whole trees - and the entire dramaturgy is that the audience does the arithmetic itself. grimdark is the right idiom because it is measured to work on MATERIAL rather than on value: mud and rust under flat light, nothing clean. That leaves the cold grade free to do the temperature, which matters because prompting for darkness is the oldest measured failure in this project - night, dark background moved mean luma 170 to 161, i.e. nothing. wear 3 is doing real work: torn clothing, dirt, exhaustion, dishevelled, which is how the climb gets told without a shot of the climb. The insert is placed third rather than last so the bone lands before the react, and the react is therefore of something the audience has already understood. It ends on hold_silent with the figure small and the drop open, which is the only honest ending: nothing has arrived yet.
note: Expected to land: mud and rust material, the cold grade, wear 3 on the two person beats. Note that establish, insert and pillow drop the character entirely, so emotion and wear contribute nothing to shots 1, 3 and 5 - the fear is carried by shot 4 alone and that is intentional. Uncertain: dragon_roost is a vast-scale card and grimdark is authored around close material texture, so the two may pull against each other at the extreme wide - if the establish comes back as generic rock, the fix is the claw gouges and the nest, not more style. pace normal rather than slow because hold_silent at 5.5s already sits just under the 6s clip. No weather layer is set, and that is deliberate: /api/compose flags weather_vs_place whenever a place card already carries its own weather, and it does here. The atmosphere is written into the place card and the shot descs as nouns instead, which is where it lands. (dragon_roost already carries wind-torn cloud.) transition is intent only - short.py ignores transitions and hard-cuts every join, so do not build a beat around it. Nothing in this card has been rendered - the GPU was committed to another job while it was written - so status is untested rather than partial. What IS checked: every id here exists in its library, and the style/place/look stack was resolved through POST /api/compose, which returned the intended engine and no error-severity conflict.
